const compareCmd = `python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.lint import AT_TOKEN_RE, MARKUP_RE
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path(".")
task = root / ".ai/task/repair-w48-20260928"
files = ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-orcs.lua")
wanted_r2 = {
    "e983810c8cf9bb078525284781ccc9705bc260ce9f0c3209485bd91c19f464d0",
    "a9fdf64994c6f59f7ff7c25bfc0ac446d8efe8cbe8731557a419d5b7ccd8e24a",
}
workset = json.loads((task / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
assert len(workset) == 22
allowed = {
    (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag")): item
    for item in workset
}
assert len(allowed) == 22
by_revision = {item["entry_revision_identity"]: item for item in workset}
snapshot = json.loads((task / "CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r2a1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["payload"]["translation_snapshot"]
assert len(snapshot) == 22
snapshot_by_revision = {row["revision_key"]: row for row in snapshot}
assert set(snapshot_by_revision) == set(by_revision)

loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
placeholder_re = re.compile(r"%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]")
changed_from_baseline = {}
current_by_revision = {}
record_counts = {}
stable = ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")

for filename in files:
    before = loader.load_path(task / "baseline" / filename, logical_path=filename).translations
    after = loader.load_path(root / filename, logical_path=filename).translations
    assert len(before) == len(after)
    record_counts[filename] = len(after)
    for old, new in zip(before, after):
        assert all(old.get(k) == new.get(k) for k in stable), (filename, new.get("line"), "metadata")
        key = (filename, new["section"], new["source"], new.get("source_tag"))
        item = allowed.get(key)
        if item is not None:
            current_by_revision[item["entry_revision_identity"]] = new
        if old["target"] == new["target"]:
            continue
        assert item is not None, (filename, new.get("line"), "outside workset")
        assert old["target"] == item["target_preimage"], item["entry_revision_identity"]
        revision = item["entry_revision_identity"]
        assert revision not in changed_from_baseline
        changed_from_baseline[revision] = new["target"]

assert set(changed_from_baseline) == set(by_revision)
assert len(changed_from_baseline) == 22
assert set(current_by_revision) == set(by_revision)

changed_from_r2 = set()
for revision, old in snapshot_by_revision.items():
    new = current_by_revision[revision]
    assert old["source"] == new["source"], revision
    if old["target"] != new["target"]:
        changed_from_r2.add(revision)
    assert old["target"].count("\\n") == new["target"].count("\\n"), (revision, "LF")
    assert [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in old["target"].split("\\n")] == [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in new["target"].split("\\n")], (revision, "TAB")
    assert placeholder_re.findall(new["source"]) == placeholder_re.findall(new["target"]), (revision, "placeholder")
    assert MARKUP_RE.findall(new["source"]) == MARKUP_RE.findall(new["target"]), (revision, "markup")
    assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new["source"]) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new["target"]), (revision, "at-token")

assert changed_from_r2 == wanted_r2
assert current_by_revision[next(x for x in wanted_r2 if x.startswith("e983"))]["target"].endswith("每一只参战的小劣魔都为我们的事业作出了巨大贡献。")
assert "把环境中的魔力转化为身体所需的能量" in current_by_revision[next(x for x in wanted_r2 if x.startswith("a9fd"))]["target"]
for filename in files:
    data = (root / filename).read_bytes()
    assert b"\\r" not in data, filename

print(json.dumps({
    "lua_runtime": "manifest LuaJIT via LocaleLoader",
    "loaded_baseline_files": 3,
    "loaded_current_files": 3,
    "record_counts": record_counts,
    "baseline_changed_targets": len(changed_from_baseline),
    "baseline_workset_exact": True,
    "r2_changed_targets": len(changed_from_r2),
    "r2_changed_revisions_exact": sorted(changed_from_r2),
    "metadata_drift": 0,
    "lf_tab_markup_placeholder_drift": 0,
    "lf_only": True,
}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY`;
const calls = await Promise.all([
  tools.exec_command({cmd:compareCmd,workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"是否允许我运行用户要求的 manifest LuaJIT 有界比较，验证基线 22 条与本轮 2 条精确差异？"}),

  tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --check",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"是否允许我运行用户要求的 git diff 空白检查？","prefix_rule":["git","diff","--check"]})
]);
calls.forEach((r,i)=>text(JSON.stringify({validation:i+1,exit_code:r.exit_code,output:r.output})));

workset = json.loads((task / "WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
assert len(workset) == 22
allowed = {
    (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag")): item
    for item in workset
}
assert len(allowed) == 22
by_revision = {item["entry_revision_identity"]: item for item in workset}
snapshot = json.loads((task / "CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r2a1.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["payload"]["translation_snapshot"]
assert len(snapshot) == 22
snapshot_by_revision = {row["revision_key"]: row for row in snapshot}
assert set(snapshot_by_revision) == set(by_revision)

loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
placeholder_re = re.compile(r"%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]")
changed_from_baseline = {}
current_by_revision = {}
record_counts = {}
stable = ("kind", "function_name", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")

for filename in files:
    before = loader.load_path(task / "baseline" / filename, logical_path=filename).translations
    after = loader.load_path(root / filename, logical_path=filename).translations
    assert len(before) == len(after)
    record_counts[filename] = len(after)
    for old, new in zip(before, after):
        assert all(old.get(k) == new.get(k) for k in stable), (filename, new.get("line"), "metadata")
        key = (filename, new["section"], new["source"], new.get("source_tag"))
        item = allowed.get(key)
        if item is not None:
            current_by_revision[item["entry_revision_identity"]] = new
        if old["target"] == new["target"]:
            continue
        assert item is not None, (filename, new.get("line"), "outside workset")
        assert old["target"] == item["target_preimage"], item["entry_revision_identity"]
        revision = item["entry_revision_identity"]
        assert revision not in changed_from_baseline
        changed_from_baseline[revision] = new["target"]

assert set(changed_from_baseline) == set(by_revision)
assert len(changed_from_baseline) == 22
assert set(current_by_revision) == set(by_revision)

changed_from_r2 = set()
for revision, old in snapshot_by_revision.items():
    new = current_by_revision[revision]
    assert old["source"] == new["source"], revision
    if old["target"] != new["target"]:
        changed_from_r2.add(revision)
    assert old["target"].count("\\n") == new["target"].count("\\n"), (revision, "LF")
    assert [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in old["target"].split("\\n")] == [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in new["target"].split("\\n")], (revision, "TAB")
    assert placeholder_re.findall(old["target"]) == placeholder_re.findall(new["target"]), (revision, "placeholder")
    assert MARKUP_RE.findall(old["target"]) == MARKUP_RE.findall(new["target"]), (revision, "markup")
    assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(old["target"]) == AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(new["target"]), (revision, "at-token")

assert changed_from_r2 == wanted_r2
assert current_by_revision[next(x for x in wanted_r2 if x.startswith("e983"))]["target"].endswith("每一只参战的小劣魔都为我们的事业作出了巨大贡献。")
assert "把环境中的魔力转化为身体所需的能量" in current_by_revision[next(x for x in wanted_r2 if x.startswith("a9fd"))]["target"]
for filename in files:
    assert b"\\r" not in (root / filename).read_bytes(), filename

print(json.dumps({
    "lua_runtime": "manifest LuaJIT via LocaleLoader",
    "loaded_baseline_files": 3,
    "loaded_current_files": 3,
    "record_counts": record_counts,
    "baseline_changed_targets": len(changed_from_baseline),
    "baseline_workset_exact": True,
    "r2_changed_targets": len(changed_from_r2),
    "r2_changed_revisions_exact": sorted(changed_from_r2),
    "metadata_drift": 0,
    "r2_target_lf_tab_markup_placeholder_drift": 0,
    "lf_only": True,
}, ensure_ascii=False))
PY`;
